data.one_liner: Dart API for the JSON-based protocol for package build and link hooks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart library for writing `hook/build.dart` and `hook/link.dart` scripts to automate building or gathering assets and performing whole-application optimization.
use_when: You are building or gathering code assets or native binaries for a Dart package
You need to run custom build tasks during a Dart build via hook scripts
avoid_when: You are developing standard pure-Dart packages that do not require native asset compilation or hooks
strengths: Standardized protocol for native assets and hooks in Dart
weaknesses: Niche package restricted to native asset and hook workflows
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up build and link scripts within the `hook/` directory of your Dart package.
